title: Connect Groups
description: Connect Groups are small communities where parishioners gather for prayer, fellowship, and faith-filled conversation. They help us grow in friendship, support one another, and bring the Gospel into everyday life.
audienceItems: Adults and families seeking a welcoming faith community
New parishioners looking to connect and build friendships
Anyone interested in prayerful small-group discussion
Catholics who want to grow in discipleship and community

contentBlocks.heading: Faith & Friendship
contentBlocks.body: Meet with a welcoming group for Scripture discussion, prayer, and encouragement.

contentBlocks.heading: Life Together
contentBlocks.body: Build meaningful relationships and share your faith walk in a supportive community.

contentBlocks.heading: What to expect
contentBlocks.body: Each Connect Group is rooted in prayer, scripture, and pastoral care. Groups meet regularly to learn together, pray together, and support one another in living out the faith in daily life.
